entities.summary: Michael O'Connor, S.J. was an Irish-born prelate of the Roman Catholic Church in the United States and a member of the Society of Jesus. He served twice as bishop of the Diocese of Pittsburgh in Pennsylvania. O'Connor served briefly as bishop of the Diocese of Erie in Pennsylvania for several months in 1853.
